scope: Art assets only. Gameplay owns terrain IDs, automatic biome selection, placement, collision and density.
placement: Each returned root starts at [0,0,0], with the lowest actual vertex at local Y=0. root.position.set(tileX, groundY, tileZ) is safe. Bounds describe the local art extent, not a collision footprint.

jungle.label: Jungle
jungle.description: Buttressed crowns, arching palms and broad understory leaves.

temperate.label: Temperate
temperate.description: The established broadleaf and pine, with meadow shrubs and tufts.

snow.label: Snow
snow.description: Narrow snowy spruce, open alpine boughs and low winter plants.

dry.label: Dry grassland
dry.description: Flat spreading acacia, angular scrub and straw tussocks.

wetlands.label: Wetlands
wetlands.description: Flared cypress, hanging willow, reeds and broad marsh leaves.
